title: Measures to Enhance Road Safety Apart from Licensing Cyclists
what_it_is: Measures to Enhance Road Safety Apart from Licensing Cyclists

sections.label: Building more cycling paths
sections.summary: Cycling paths will be built within and between towns, growing from about 460 kilometres today to more than 1,300 kilometres by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Where possible, we will separate bicycles from motor vehicles by providing cycling paths.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We are building more cycling paths, within and between towns, from about 460 kilometres today to more than 1,300 kilometres by 2030.

sections.label: Penalties for errant cyclists
sections.summary: Errant cyclists can face up to a $1,000 fine and a six-month jail term for a first offence, with higher penalties for repeat offenders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Errant cyclists can face up to a $1,000 fine and a six-month jail term for the first offence, with higher penalties for repeat offenders.

sections.label: AMAP reviewing safety rules
sections.summary: AMAP is reviewing whether safety rules need strengthening and penalties increased, studying public suggestions on single-file riding and group size limits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: AMAP is also reviewing if our safety rules need to be strengthened and whether existing penalties need to be increased.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For example, it is studying suggestions from the public on whether cyclists should be required to ride in a single file at all times on the roads and if there should be limits on group sizes for on-road cycling.

sections.label: AMAP review still ongoing
sections.summary: AMAP is still doing its review and has not come to any landing point at this moment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: First, to clarify, AMAP is currently still doing its review.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: It has not come to any landing point at this moment.

sections.label: Covering open drains in Toa Payoh
sections.summary: In Toa Payoh, agencies including LTA and PUB are working to cover up open drains and convert them into wider footpaths.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Just to give an example, in Toa Payoh, where I am looking after the town, we are working together with LTA, PUB and also the other agencies to cover up some of the open drains and convert them into wider footpaths.

sections.label: Reinforcement versus curriculum content
sections.summary: The speaker says this requires continuous reinforcement and is unsure about putting it into the already heavy curriculum.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I think this is something which requires continuous reinforcement along the way.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I am not sure whether we want to put it into the curriculum because the curriculum is already, I think, very heavy with different content.

sections.label: Cyclists riding two abreast rules
sections.summary: On multi-lane roads cyclists may ride two abreast in the left-most lane, but must ride single file on single-lane roads to prevent obstruction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I also urge drivers to bear in mind that if you are driving past cyclists, please remember that they are more vulnerable on the roads.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And I think it is important to also remember that the current rule on a multi-lane road is that it is not against the rule for cyclists to ride on the left-most lane but riding two abreast.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: They need not be in a single file.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: They are only required to ride in a single file if they are riding on a road with a single lane.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: That is mainly to prevent obstruction to traffic.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But on a multi-lane road, and if they are riding on the left-most lane, they are currently allowed to ride two abreast.

sections.label: AMAP reviewing cycling rule
sections.summary: AMAP is reviewing the current rule and looking at the trade-offs, which have valid reasons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: There are some valid reasons as well why this rule is currently crafted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But as I have said earlier, AMAP is reviewing, they are looking at the trade-offs.
